description: Encrypt a PDF with a password. user_password is required to open the result; owner_password lifts the permission restrictions. Give at least one (each 1 to 32 Latin-1 chars). permissions lists what stays ALLOWED from print, copy, modify, annotate, fill-forms (default all, except modify when an owner password is set; an empty list allows none). Restrictions only bind viewers when an owner password is set. Not byte-deterministic (random salts). Returns the result inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

permissions.description: Actions to ALLOW; omit for the default, [] for none

user_password.description: Password required to open the output

name: pdf_protect

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Password-protect PDF
